svg.title: Her Story: what the war did to Palestinian women
svg.desc: Documented figures on Palestinian women and girls: more than 38,000 women and girls killed in Gaza between October 2023 and December 2025 according to UN Women, at least 47 a day; about 16,000 widows, one in seven families now headed by a woman; nearly 790,000 women and girls in crisis or catastrophic food insecurity; nearly 11,000 left with lifelong disabilities; and UN-documented sexual and gender-based violence in detention and at checkpoints. English and Arabic labels.
svg.text: What Palestinian women survived — and what they carry now
ما نجت منه الفلسطينيات.. وما يحملنه الآن

g.text: 1 in 7 families led by a woman
أرملة.. أسرة من كل سبع تعيلها امرأة

svg.text: WHAT UN INVESTIGATORS DOCUMENTED · ما وثّقه محققو الأمم المتحدة

g.text: Sexual assault in detention — strip searches by male soldiers, reported rapes, threats of rape
Invasive body searches and sexual harassment at homes and checkpoints in the West Bank
Settler sexual violence, often in the presence of Israeli forces, rarely investigated
Nearly 11,000 women and girls wounded into lifelong disability
اعتداءات جنسية في الاعتقال وتفتيش عارٍ وتهديد بالاغتصاب
تفتيش جسدي مهين وتحرش على الحواجز وفي البيوت بالضفة
عنف جنسي من المستوطنين نادراً ما يُحقَّق فيه

svg.text: Every number here was a woman with a name. This section is where we print the names.
كل رقم هنا امرأة لها اسم.. وهنا نكتب الأسماء
Graphic: Times of Palestine · Sources: UN Women (Apr 2026); UN Commission of Inquiry (Mar 2025); UN special rapporteurs (Feb 2024, Apr 2026)
